note: Invented: a repair-cafe booking for a toaster.
title: Toaster that trips the fuse

tabs.label: Overview
facts: Two-slot toaster, about nine years old
The fuse trips when the lever goes down
tabs.text: The element looks intact. Tomas suspects the lever contacts, which are cheap to replace, and will check insulation first.

tabs.label: History
events: Ines booked the slot and described the fault.
Tomas asked for a photo of the base.
Ines sent the photo: scorch mark near the lever.

tabs.label: Answer
tabs.question: Replace the lever contacts, or advise the owner to retire the toaster?
tabs.why: A scorch mark near live contacts can mean the fault is bigger than the contacts. Retiring it is safe but costs the owner a toaster.
